name: Augustus' Receipt Book
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. narrative.details:
I'm ready for business!  What you do want?

Oh wait... I can't open up shop without my receipt book.  How am I to keep track of things without my receipt book?

I must have left it in town somewhere.  I had a room in the inn... the book must be there.

Bring me my book.  Please, bring it to me!  Bring me my book and you'll see!  I'll set up shop and you'll see that my prices are INSANE!
narrative.objectives: Bring Augustus' Receipt Book to Augustus the Touched in Terrordale.
narrative.offerRewardText:
There it is! And oh my! I forgot how full it was!

This is a glorious day, adventurer! Stupendous! Insanely good, I say!
narrative.requestItemsText: Do you have my receipt book? I can't wait to get back to business!
